$schema: Canonical product list for the public digital shop and the Google Merchant Center feed. Edit this file when prices, copy or availability change — the shop pages, the merchant XML/CSV feeds and the checkout call all read from it. Keep the merchant feed values (gtin, mpn, condition, availability, priceCurrency) in sync with Google's product data specification.

products.title: One-page business website starter
products.shortDescription: A clean, mobile-ready one-page website starter for a small business, with a contact form and the four sections every Nigerian small business needs.
products.longDescription: A working one-page website you can publish in an afternoon. Comes as editable source files plus a short setup guide that walks you through putting it on a free host and pointing your domain at it. Built with the same plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript the academy teaches in the Web Development classes, so you can read the code and learn how it works as you customise it.
products.imageAlt: A flat illustration of a single-page website preview with sections for services, about, contact and a call to action.
highlights: Mobile-ready layout that works on phones, tablets and desktops
Editable HTML/CSS/JS — no proprietary builder lock-in
Contact form with mailto fallback so it works on any host
Setup guide covering free hosting, domain pointing and SSL
requirements: A computer running Windows, macOS or Linux
Any modern browser to preview the file as you edit
About an hour to read the setup guide and publish the page
products.license: Single-project commercial use. Resale or redistribution of the source files is not included.

products.title: Invoice and stock sheet for small shops
products.shortDescription: An Excel-and-Google-Sheets compatible invoice and stock tracker built around how Nigerian retail shops actually buy, sell and reconcile.
products.longDescription: A working spreadsheet for daily shop use: one tab for invoices you issue, one for invoices you receive, one for stock in and stock out, and one summary that shows what you owe and what is owed to you. Comes with a written guide explaining the columns, the formulas, and how to switch between Excel and Google Sheets without breaking the totals. Replaces the paper ledger most small shops still keep.
products.imageAlt: A flat illustration of a paper invoice and a small spreadsheet grid with rows for items and totals.
products.fileFormat: XLSX (also opens in Google Sheets, LibreOffice, Numbers)
highlights: Issue invoices and record supplier bills in one workbook
Stock-in / stock-out tracker with running balances
Summary tab showing what you owe and what is owed to you
Works in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets without reformatting
requirements: Microsoft Excel 2016 or later, or a free Google account for Google Sheets
Basic comfort entering numbers into cells
About 30 minutes to set up your shop name, address and first products
products.license: Single-shop commercial use. Resale of the template as-is is not included.

products.title: Weekly social content planner
products.shortDescription: A weekly content planner for one small business — captions, hashtags, image prompts and a posting schedule across Instagram, Facebook and X.
products.longDescription: A planner that covers one week at a time, with seven caption frameworks, a hashtag bank, image prompts that don't require a designer, and a posting-time guide for Nigerian audiences. Built for a one-person marketing team, not an agency. Comes with example weeks you can copy from and a checklist to review before each post goes live.
products.imageAlt: A flat illustration of a weekly calendar grid with coloured post slots and a small phone showing a feed.
highlights: Seven caption frameworks for everyday small business posts
Hashtag bank curated for Nigerian Instagram, Facebook and X
Image prompts you can shoot on a phone without a designer
Posting-time guide tuned to Nigerian audience patterns
requirements: Any device that can open a PDF (phone, tablet, laptop)
An active Instagram, Facebook or X account
About an hour to fill in your first week
products.license: Single-business use. Resale of the planner as-is is not included.
